Agent Ready State Surviving Outbound Calls on Break
When an agent is on break and makes an outbound call, two SIP sessions exist simultaneously: the break (ready) session and the outbound session. When the outbound call ends,
fires for the outbound session — but the break session is still alive.

The SDK instance contains JsSIP internals (WebSocket connections, SIP UA, media streams). Wrapping it in Vue's deep-reactive
causes proxied getters/setters on those objects, which breaks SIP stack behaviour.

import { shallowRef } from 'vue'
const sdk = shallowRef(null)
sdk.value = new window.SocioVoice.Init({ ... })
sdk.value.start()

import { ref } from 'vue'
const sdk = ref(null)       // deep reactivity wraps JsSIP internals — causes subtle failures
sdk.value = new window.SocioVoice.Init({ ... })
// deep reactivity wraps JsSIP internals — causes subtle failures
